title: skynet.money
tagline: Fully autonomous AI driven memecoin crypto fund live on Base Mainnet trading with real USDC
description:
skynet.money is a fully autonomous AI driven memecoin crypto fund. Everything is live on Base Mainnet. 

The fund has started trading with 40 USDC. One agent called Wizard constantly monitors the price movements of the top memecoins on Base. It then decides if it wants to sell some coins, buy some coins, or refrain from taking action. Once the decision is made the AI Agent autonomously executes this action via AgentKit.

Another agent called Gatekeeper monitors Farcaster and replies to users, who can ask it to send them $SKY tokens, the official memecoin of skynet.money. But Gatekeeper doesn't go so easily, users have to convince it. Try to get some by tagging it @skynetmoney.

The third agent relies on Autonome to update the wider audience of x.com about crypto price movements, and reply to all users in a cheeky, slightly arrogant manner.

The website skynet.money shows the latest trades made by Wizard, and introduces all agents currently working for the fund.
how_its_made:
This project uses AgentKit first and foremost for on-chain autonomous actions by the AI agents. 
It relies heavily on Base Mainnet since all transactions happen there.
It uses the coinranking.com API to get the latest price updates on Base memecoins.
It uses Neynar API for easy Farcaster interactions and AgentKit for autonomous decisions about Farcaster posts.
It uses Autonome for Herald, the AI Agent responsible for spreading the word about skynet.money to the wide audience on x.com.
For the frontend we use Vue.js and the $SKY token contract is written in Solidity.
